name: Moocha
source:
Moocha is a gentle-natured cow who's the original owner of Banana Ranch. His kind-hearted nature and honest-to-goodness nature make him unsuitable to become a business owner, as he is sometimes too kind for his own good.

All he wants in this life is to make others healthy with his milk!
translation:
Moocha is a gentle-natured cow who's the original owner of Banana Ranch. His kind-hearted nature and honest-to-goodness nature make him unsuitable to become a business owner, as he is sometimes too kind for his own good.

All he wants in this life is to make others healthy with his milk!
